metadata.Name: Polyglot-NER
metadata.Description: A massively multilingual dataset for named entity recognition (NER) created by leveraging Wikipedia and its inter-language links. It contains silver-standard annotations for over 100 languages, generated using cross-lingual projection from English models.
metadata.Paper Title: Polyglot-NER: Massive Multilingual Named Entity Recognition
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of the 2015 SIAM International Conference on Data Mining
metadata.Venue Name: SIAM International Conference on Data Mining
metadata.Abstract: We introduce a massively multilingual dataset for named entity recognition (NER). The dataset is created by leveraging Wikipedia and its inter-language links. We use a novel combination of noisy-label learning and cross-lingual projection to transfer English NER models to more than 100 languages. The resulting models are used to create a large silver-standard dataset of NER annotations. We show that training a standard NER model on the silver-standard annotations leads to a large improvement over a baseline trained on the projected labels. We also show that our models are competitive with state-of-the-art models on standard NER benchmarks. The dataset and the models are released to the public.
